name: Barbarian audit: Plugging the Hole's spell modifier and bleed-removal effect both work natively (#1217)
contract: Audit report #1217 flags 561314 for a missing script. Effect 0 is a native spell-mod aura (107 flat, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN op 11 on 807046) -- covered below and already proven. Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY (type 3) with EffectMiscValue 524287 and EffectTriggerSpell 560460 ('Torpedo'), which has an empty DBC description and an unrelated single-target speed-increase aura (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED) plus its own dummy effect -- nothing that resembles a bleed removal, and no spell_proc/spell_linked_spell row or C++ script anywhere references 561314 or 560460. But 561314's own tooltip ('Your Skull Smash now removes all bleed effects on the enemy') is not a promise this DUMMY effect needs to keep: Skull Smash's (560532) own DBC description carries the client-side conditional macro '$?s561314[ Removes all bleed effects on the target.][]', and its effect 2 (SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST -> 560554, SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL_MECHANIC misc 15 = MECHANIC_BLEED, confirmed in the #1144 Skull Smash scenario) already performs that exact removal generically, with no per-spell script (grep confirmed no code references 560532, 560554, 561314 or 560460 anywhere in src/ or modules/). Aura::CalcDispelChance returns 100% chance absent a SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST source, so a plain dummy creature's bleed is removed deterministically. Effect 1 of 561314 is therefore dead/vestigial DBC data -- like #2550 and #2566 in this same audit -- not a functional gap: the tooltip's promise is already delivered by Skull Smash's own unconditional effect, so there is nothing left for 561314's own DUMMY effect to implement.
